title: Startup Needs Sorter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Entrepreneurship
description: A six-card sorting quiz in which learners classify items a founder is considering buying for a mobile dog-grooming idea as a Genuine Need or a want that can wait, with immediate green or amber feedback and a one-sentence explanation for each card.

prerequisites: Chapter 6: Designing the Solution & Initial Offer
educational.topic: Needs vs. wants assessment for startup needs
learningObjectives: Classify items a founder is considering purchasing as a Genuine Need or a want that can wait by applying the needs vs. wants assessment

controls.label: Genuine Need
controls.purpose: Classify the current item as a one-time need the first lean test cannot run without

controls.label: Can Wait (Want)
controls.purpose: Classify the current item as a want that can wait until after the lean test

controls.label: Try Again
controls.purpose: Reshuffle the cards and start over

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classification quiz with immediate corrective feedback
keyQuestions: Could the first lean test happen without this item?
Could this item be borrowed, rented, or shared for the first lean test instead of bought?
commonMisconceptions: Anything a real, established business has is a startup need
Only physical items count as needs, so a license or insurance can wait
assessmentOpportunities: Score at least 5 of 6 on a second, shuffled attempt
Sort five items from your own venture's resource list
